correctness.rationale: Identify R_{m,n} with line graph of K_{m,n}. Three GP vertices on a length-two geodesic correspond exactly to 3-edge bipartite paths P4; P4-free bipartite edge subsets are star forests. Their labeled component series is B=xyz+x(exp(zy)-1-zy)+y(exp(zx)-1-zx). Including isolated original vertices gives P=m!n![x^my^n]exp(x+y+B). Inclusion maximality has exactly the disjoint cases no isolated bipartite vertices, only unused left with left-centered stars of size≥2, only unused right with right-centered stars of size≥2; this gives M=m!n![x^my^n](exp(B)+(exp(x)-1)exp L+(exp(y)-1)exp R). Spanning forest with c=2..m components gives n..m+n-2 edges, one-sided families give m or n. Minimum boundary multiplicities are restricted Stirling numbers. Independent exhaustive masks on boards 2x5,3x5,4x4 reproduced M_{2,5}=5z²+32z^5, M_{3,5}=5z³+213z^5+15z^6, M_{4,4}=104z^4+144z^5+16z^6.
